$comment: Invariant ids owned by the P2 task `p2-g1-g2-analyze-band` (G1 Analyze, G2 Band, the lemma ledger). The tests exist, they are green, and they are named with their ids — but `owned` is EMPTY, because `pnpm test:coverage-map` cannot see a Python test today and would report MISS on an id that has an owning test. Putting the ids in `owned` would turn CI red for a reason that has nothing to do with this lane; leaving them out silently is worse. So they are listed under `ownedPendingCoverageMapPythonSupport` with the exact change that moves them, and the integrate lane makes that change and moves the array. See `blockers` below.

blockers.what: scripts/coverage-map.ts walks TEST_ROOTS = ['packages', 'apps', 'e2e'] for TEST_FILE_PATTERN = /\.(test|spec)\.(ts|tsx)$|\.ya?ml$/, and finds a claim with a JS-shaped regex: /\b(?:it|test)(?:\.\w+)*\s*\(\s*(['"`])([\s\S]*?)\1/. Nothing under tools/ is scanned and no Python test-name shape is recognised, so every invariant the content pipeline owns is unownable by construction. That is not specific to this lane — INV-PACK-13, INV-PACK-15 and INV-PACK-17 hit it next.
blockers.fix: Add 'tools' to TEST_ROOTS, add /^test_.*\.py$|_test\.py$/ to TEST_FILE_PATTERN, and add a second claim pattern for Python that reads the id out of a test's NAME or its first docstring line: /def\s+(test_\w+)\s*\([^)]*\)[^:]*:\s*(?:(['\"])\2?\2?([\s\S]*?)\2)?/ is enough, or more simply scan `def test_...` blocks for a bracketed id in the following docstring. Also add '.venv' and '.ruff_cache' to SKIP_DIRS, or the walk enters the installed packages.
blockers.whoFixesIt: the P2 integrate task — scripts/ is outside this lane's file ownership
blockers.thenDo: move the two ids from `ownedPendingCoverageMapPythonSupport` into `owned`

blockers.what: tools/coursekit/tests/test_cli.py::test_discovery_finds_nothing_yet_and_that_is_the_correct_state asserts `STAGES.missing(BUILD_STAGE_IDS) == BUILD_STAGE_IDS`. This lane registers g1 and g2, so that equality no longer holds. The test's own docstring says it is there so 'the day a lane lands coursekit/stages/g0.py this test is the thing that tells them the wiring worked' — it is doing its job, and it is in `p2-deps-scaffold`'s file lane, not this one.
blockers.fix: Replace the two asserts with `assert 'g1' not in STAGES.missing(BUILD_STAGE_IDS)` and a list of the stages still unregistered, so the signal survives instead of being deleted.
blockers.whoFixesIt: the P2 integrate task — tests/test_cli.py is outside this lane's file ownership

blockers.what: `p2-deps-scaffold` created empty `config/analyze.py` (owner 'p2-g1-analyze') and `config/band.py` (owner 'p2-g2-band'); this task's file lane names `config/g1.py` and `config/g2.py`. The live constants are in g1.py/g2.py. The two empty files must be DELETED, not filled in — INV-PACK-40 is about a declaration existing exactly once, and two plausible homes for a ledger constant is how the second declaration gets written.

heldWithoutAnInvariantId: The adapter self-test corpus (config/g1.ADAPTER_SELFTEST_ES): twelve ORIGINAL A1 Spanish sentences and the exact surface/lemma/UPOS string es_core_news_md 3.8.0 produces for each, plus a sha256 the adapter checks at import so the table and its digest cannot drift apart. It exists because the wheel-URL pin is not sufficient on its own: a contributor's stale venv, a patched spaCy or a stray spacy-lookups-data re-partitions the lemma ledger, which retro-introduces lemmas before their introduction unit and makes V1 pass vacuously — every test downstream of G2 re-derives the ledger with the new lemmatiser and agrees with itself. The sentences sit on the seams (al/del contractions, clitic se, gender and number agreement, ser/estar, existential hay, preterite) and four of the frozen answers are wrong Spanish (Nosotros->yo, se->él, muy->mucho, trabajé unlemmatised) and are frozen anyway, because the table records what the pinned model DOES

hermitdave's CC BY-SA 4.0 duty is discharged in code, not in a comment: g2_band writes derived_ordering_licence, derived_ordering_share_alike and a named attribution string into the runlog, and a test asserts all three on a real run. An ordering derived from CC BY-SA content is a derivative of it; the pack's CC BY-NC-SA is compatible, but shipping it without declaring it redistributes an SA derivative without passing the licence on

config/g2.ELELEX_LICENCE carries the reasoning beside the constant, and a test greps for it: ELELex is CC BY-NC-SA and is usable HERE ONLY because the plan's licence split makes packs CC BY-NC-SA while code stays AGPL-3.0. The block states what may not be done with it — never vendored into this repository, never moved into packages/ or apps/ — because the next person to find the constant will be looking for something to reuse

R23 is enforced structurally, not just documented: banded_lemma has no section_cefr field, unit_assignment does, and a test asserts both plus that build_rows never emits one. The measured product attaches CEFR to SECTIONS (Spanish ships 8: 1-3 A1, 4 A2, 5-6 B1, 7-8 B2), which is a G3 curriculum output; a per-lemma lexicon cannot produce it and a frequency decile cannot either

NEW FINDING, same class as R3 and R11: `deep/10` §S4 says ELELex's FreeLing POS maps via `freeling_to_elelex.yaml` beside the TSV. That path 404s (verified 2026-09-12, four spellings; the server answers with 1,165 bytes of HTML, so an unchecked fetch gets an error page and a mapping of nothing). config/g2.FREELING_TO_UD is ours, written against the EAGLES tagset and the 40 distinct tags the published file actually contains, and multiword rows ('NCM, NP0', 'VM VM') map to nothing rather than being guessed at

NEW FINDING, measured: a bare surface form is a bad place to read a POS from. es_core_news_md tags 6.1% of the top 3,000 Spanish surface forms as PROPN when each is its own one-token document — casa, perro and hola among them — which would split casa/PROPN from casas/NOUN into two ledger rows, the exact failure lemmatising hermitdave's list exists to prevent. So G2 takes the POS from G1's in-context corpus wherever the corpus has the lemma, falls back to the context-free tag only for the tail, consolidates a lemma's competing tags onto the one with the most evidence, and reports all four counts

ELELex's banding threshold is calibrated against the real file rather than chosen: at >= 1 document per level the 14,290 entries partition completely (A1 3674 / A2 3576 / B1 3018 / B2 2119 / C1 1903); at >= 3 documents 9,430 of them fall out and silently revert to the decile proxy while the pack still claims CEFR-checked. The distribution is in the constant's docstring so raising the number is a visible decision

The frequency list is read from a LOCAL file and G2 never fetches: a stage that downloads on demand makes every run depend on whatever `master` says today, which is the same moving-input hazard the spaCy wheel-URL pin exists for. A short file, and a 404 HTML body, are both refused by name rather than read as a language with no vocabulary

G1 reports mean content-words-per-sentence for the pack and fails the stage when any sentence falls outside the pack's own length window. That second check is the numeric half of INV-PACK-40's grep gate: a G0 that counted its own tokens lets through sentences the ledger measures outside the window, and the code gate cannot see a pre-built G0 output
